correctness.rationale: The four triangles and their unique between-triangle neighbors determine every graph automorphism; all 24 label permutations occur. A barycentric flag has distinct ranks, so its closed simplex maps injectively to the quotient (equivalent barycentric points must have the same rank support and coefficients). The ordered flag facets therefore give the genuine regular orbit cells, not a Borel or rational surrogate. A separate exact implementation, /workspace/review-work/orbit_check.py (run with argument 2), enumerated all flags via ordered partitions and used a different indexing and elimination order. It recovered 162 faces, 3342 flags, orbit cells (11,42,63,30), 60 elementary collapses, and residual cells (6,12,8). It eliminated all seven generators in the residual triangular presentation, and exact integer pivots left one generator in degrees zero and two. Spanning-tree contraction and the displayed single-occurrence relator substitutions validate the supplied 2-dimensional homotopy argument; independently, simple connectivity and the calculated integral homology give a generator map S^2 to the quotient by Hurewicz, then a homotopy equivalence by homological Whitehead.
residual_risks: The finite computation concerns this exact action; it neither provides a homeomorphism of the original quotient to S^2 nor classifies quotients by proper subgroups.
